sloka: उपस्थापय शीघ्रम् मे चारान् नीति विशारदान् ।महोदरस्तथोक्तस्तु शीघ्रमाज्ञापयच्चरान् ॥६-२९-१७॥।।
transliteration: upasthāpaya śīghram me cārān nīti viśāradān ।mahodarastathoktastu śīghramājñāpayaccarān ॥6-29-17॥।।

translations.english: (Ravana) Having said so, Mahodara ordered the spies to approach the king quickly. On reaching they greeted the king with folded hand s promoting h i m to' be victorious' and stood.
